name: What types of materials are used for window flashing repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for window flashing repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Various materials are used for window flashing repair, each chosen for its durability and weather resistance. Common materials include self-adhered membranes (peel-and-stick flashing), flexible or rigid metal flashing (aluminum, copper, galvanized steel), and liquid-applied flashing sealants. The best material choice depends on your specific window type, siding, and local climate conditions. We select materials that offer maximum protection against moisture, ensuring a robust and long-lasting repair that integrates well with your home's existing construction.
